game.title: Arcanum Cards

plan.title: Arcanum Cards
plan.concept: A mystical memory-matching strategy game set in a wizard’s candle-lit study. Players flip enchanted tarot-style cards to uncover matching arcane pairs like elements, runes, constellations, and potions, with each round increasing grid size and pattern complexity.
features: Theme sets: elements, runes, constellations, potions
Mystical study environment with candlelit ambience
plan.gameplay_summary: Players tap two cards at a time to reveal symbols and try to find matching pairs before the board resets. As rounds advance, the grid expands and the icon sets become more visually similar, demanding sharper memory and smarter matching choices.
plan.visual_style_summary: Deep violet, gold, and ember-lit fantasy art with ornate card frames and magical glow effects. The atmosphere feels quiet, ancient, and mysterious, like a hidden archive of spells.
plan.subject: Memory and pattern strategy
plan.learning_objective: Strengthen visual memory, pattern recognition, and strategic decision-making through progressive matching challenges.
plan.replayability: Randomized layouts and rotating theme sets keep each round fresh and encourage faster, more efficient matching.

visual_plan.visual_style_summary: Deep violet, gold, and ember-lit fantasy art with ornate card frames and magical glow effects. The atmosphere feels quiet, ancient, and mysterious, like a hidden archive of spells.

game.request: Arcanum Cards — a mystical memory matching strategy game set in a wizard's candle-lit study. Flip enchanted tarot-style cards to find matching arcane pairs: elements, runes, constellations and potions. Each round the grid grows and the themes get trickier, testing memory and pattern strategy. Deep violet and gold mystical atmosphere.

spec.title: Arcanum Cards
spec.description: Flip enchanted tarot-style cards in a wizard's candle-lit study to find matching arcane pairs. As each round advances, the grid grows and symbols grow trickier, testing your memory and pattern strategy.
spec.subject: Memory, Pattern Recognition & Strategic Thinking
spec.learning_objective: Strengthen working memory, visual pattern recognition, and strategic decision-making by matching increasingly complex arcane symbol pairs across expanding grids.
spec.controls: Tap or click any face-down card to reveal it; tap a second card to attempt a match. Matched pairs remain face-up; mismatches flip back. Clear all pairs to advance.

achievements.label: Flawless Conjurer — Match all pairs without a single mismatch
Chain of Fate — Land 4 correct matches in a row
Swift Sorcery — Complete a stage in under 30 seconds
Archmage — Complete all 6 stages
Unaided Oracle — Finish any stage without using a hint

stages.title: Stage I — The Four Classical Elements
Stage II — Elder Futhark Runes

pairs.left: ᚦ Thurisaz — Rune of the Thorn
ᚨ Ansuz — Rune of the Gods
ᚱ Raidho — Rune of the Journey
ᚲ Kenaz — Rune of the Torch

stages.title: Stage III — Zodiac Constellations
Stage IV — The Alchemist's Potions

pairs.right: ⚪ Crystallum Essence — Pure light in liquid

stages.title: Stage V — Arcane Sigils & Planetary Seals

pairs.right: ☽ Moon Sigil — The veil between worlds

pairs.left: ☉ Solar Disc — Symbol of truth & light

pairs.right: ✦ Lodestar Mark — Fixed point in chaos
⋆ Null Rune — The shape of nothing
⚷ Wounded Healer — Bridge of suffering & cure

stages.title: Stage VI — The Grand Arcanum (Major Arcana)

pairs.right: I Arcana of Creation — As above, so below
II Arcana of Mystery — The unspoken knowing
III Arcana of Flourishing — Earth's creative force
IV Arcana of Order — The throne of reason
V Arcana of the Sacred — Keeper of rites
VI Arcana of Bonds — The fork in fate's road
VII Arcana of Victory — Will over opposing forces
VIII Arcana of the Lion — Taming the beast within
